{{nihongo|'''Katasuge Shrine'''|片菅神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Miyake, Tokyo|Q1154797|qid=Q1154797}} ({{ill|Miyake-jima|Q1075076|qid=Q1075076}}), {{ill|Tokyo|Q1490|qid=Q1490}}. {{nihongo|'''Katasuge Shrine'''|片菅神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

It is enshrined in woodland to the north, off {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Tokyo Metropolitan Route 212}}, the ring road in northeastern Miyake-jima.

It is identified with the {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} '''Katasuga-no-Mikoto Shrine''' (かたすが[げ]のみことじんじゃ)<ref>[https://yaokami.jp/1131733/ 片菅神社] - Yaokami no Kami</ref><ref name="engi-chosa">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140116-01.html 片菅神社] - Research on Engishiki Shrines</ref><ref name="sh">[https://shrineheritager.com/katasuge-shrine/ 片菅神社] - Shrine-heritager</ref><ref name="jyr">[https://jun-yu-roku.com/shrine/engishiki/izu/ 伊豆國 九十二座] - Jinja Junyūroku</ref>. (However, other proposed sites include Katsuso Shrine (Katasuga-no-Mikoto Shrine), now merged into {{ill|Oshaku Shrine|Q110915859|qid=Q110915859}}; Wakamiya Shrine, a subsidiary shrine of {{ill|Kisaki Shrine|Q134930558|qid=Q134930558|lt=Kisaki Shrine}}; and {{ill|Katasuge Shrine|Q134892414|qid=Q134892414|lt=Katasuga Shrine}} in Katase, {{ill|Higashiizu|Q304491|qid=Q304491}}<ref name="sh"/><ref name="jyr"/><ref name="engi-chosa2">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140116-02.html 片菅命神社] - Research on Engishiki Shrines</ref>.)

== Enshrined deity ==
* Katasuge-no-Mikoto (かたすげのみこと) - identified as "Katasuge," the seventh child among the Eight Princes born between {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q8009611|lt=Kotoshironushi-no-Kami}} (Mishima Daimyōjin) and his consort Sakitamahime-no-Mikoto (the enshrined deity of {{ill|Oshaku Shrine|Q110915859|qid=Q110915859}})<ref name="engi-chosa"/><ref name="sh"/><ref>''{{ill|Miyakeki|Q17215100|qid=Q17215100}}''</ref>.
